name: Infinite Spiral
description: Image gallery where square cards wind around a vertical spiral, endlessly looping with depth scaling, edge fade and blur. Motion can be automatic, scroll-driven, drag-driven, or all combined.
contents: Spiral of image cards, optionally wrapped in links
Per-card alt text and aria label
behavior: Cards loop endlessly around a helix with the center card scaled up
Cards fade and blur toward the top and bottom edges
Auto mode drifts up or down and pauses on hover
Scroll mode advances the spiral as the page scrolls
Drag mode lets the user drag vertically to spin
Animation is paused when off screen and stopped for prefers-reduced-motion
Spiral radius and card scale shrink to fit the container
editableByProps: Images, links, alt text and number of cards
Spiral shape: radius, spacing, cards per turn, rotation, perspective
Card size, corner radius, tilt, center scale, image fit and grayscale
Edge fade and blur strength, hover pause, container sizing via className

needsCodeEdit.where: translate3d line inside the render function in the useEffect, and onPointerMove handler

needsCodeEdit.change: Change card border, shadow or background
needsCodeEdit.where: className of the Card element in the items map

needsCodeEdit.change: Add captions or overlays on cards
needsCodeEdit.where: Card element children next to the img in the items map

fixed: Needs a non-empty items array, otherwise nothing renders
Fills its parent: h-full with min-h-80 and overflow hidden, so the parent needs a defined height
Listens to window scroll for scroll and all modes
Drag mode sets touch-action pan-x and disables text selection, and drag blocks clicks on links
Runs a continuous requestAnimationFrame loop while mounted
Cards are fixed small by default (100px) and the spiral scales down to fit narrow containers, so very small containers show tiny cards
Needs an item count well above cardsPerTurn for a continuous loop

options.look: Spiral drifts continuously on its own and pauses on hover
options.useWhen: Hero or decorative band where the gallery should move without any input

options.look: Spiral stays still and turns as the visitor scrolls the page
options.useWhen: Long landing page where the gallery should react to page scrolling

options.look: Spiral is static until the user drags it vertically
options.useWhen: Interactive portfolio section where visitors browse by grabbing the gallery

options.look: Auto drift, scroll response and drag combined
options.useWhen: Showpiece section that should feel alive and respond to every input
